name: Points Of Interest
description: Points of interest that can be highlighted on the player's world map and minimap, e.g. when a gossip option with action_poi_id is selected or by scripts. Sent to the client with position, icon, flags and a label.

fields.name: Icon
fields.help: Client-side POI icon id shown on the map.

fields.name: Flags
fields.help: Sent raw to the client in SMSG_GOSSIP_POI.

fields.name: Data
fields.help: Extra data (importance) sent raw to the client.

fields.name: Icon Name
fields.help: Label shown next to the point of interest on the map (localizable via locales_points_of_interest).
